comparators.trigger: Train detachFromTracks / persisted MigratingPoints / earlyTick reattachToTracks
comparators.input: per-wheel old directed nodes, old edge distance, curve flag and sampled fallback position, saved train with graph absent
comparators.output: exact directed-edge reuse first; otherwise straight-edge directional geometric match; commit only a graph matching all migrating wheel points; keep failed checkpoints for retry
comparators.preservation: Actual constructor/write/read/tryMigratingTo plus Train detach/load/earlyTick/reattach and TravellingPoint.migrateTo read. Failed graphs eliminated across all points before mutations; failure sets derailed and cooldown40 without clearing checkpoints. Success maps all points, clears checkpoints, resets transit schedule and station/signal bindings. Independent actual owner/consumer review: TrackGraph.removeNode 165-176: 移除正在使用的节点触发同图车辆 detach。 Train.detachFromTracks 835-840: 遍历实际 bogey travelling points 生成检查点，再将 graph=null。 Train.write/read 1199,1242-1243: 检查点通过实际车辆持久字段恢复；earlyTick 193-200 启动重新挂接。 TrainMigration.tryMigratingTo 36-100: 优先原有向边，否则仅非曲线候选进行同方向近距离几何探测。 Train.reattachToTracks 883-928: 每点消除不匹配图，仅全点成功的图才给实际轮位迁移；失败 cooldown40、derailed=true，保留检查点。 TravellingPoint.migrateTo 407-415: 从映射列表移除首项并设置真实节点、沿边距离和边引用。 Distinction: 不是把 Train.read 的 MigratingPoints 字段再计一次。独立增量是轨道拓扑改变时，把所有轮位的旧有向边/沿边距离与空间采样点转换为新图中的一致轮位集合；失败保留检查点以便后续重试。原有车辆 owner/乘客重建账目只覆盖实体身份、乘客座位和维度恢复，未覆盖这种先完整匹配再提交的拓扑约束。完整检查点产生、持久化、恢复、实际轮位消费者合为1，TrainMigration reader/几何 helper/每轮各0。
comparators.application_limit: 原边仍存在时直接使用旧距离，未与新边长核对。 空间 fallback 不处理曲线；搜索限于距采样点32格的节点起点，以同向和1/64半径相交判定；未审核依赖维度/向量辅助类的完整语义。 HashSet 的首个全匹配图不保证确定顺序；设置 graph 后逐点 mutate，无 rollback 或跨保存事务。 未校验任意坏 NBT、点数变化、空边；静态条件下的全点预匹配不等于无损或 crash-atomic。 这是拓扑重绑定检查点研究，不是已证明历史格式版本升级或 Dynasty 原生验收。

dedup_reason: Full Navigation persistence and actual future-junction control/braking consumers independently read. Unlike f729 owned vehicle identity/passenger reconstruction, this preserves operator-selected future turns rather than physical train position. Unlike f550 itinerary instruction completion, it restores concrete currently selected route and red-signal braking state; unlike a781 all-wheel topology preflight, null route entries are discarded and mismatched junction falls back to first option rather than retaining failed wheel checkpoint. Whole route/wait checkpoint1; helper/pathfinding/field/graph wrapper0.
limits: Not earned quest progress/paid reward transaction. This is route intent and transient operational waiting checkpoint; references distinguish durable authored task/vehicle ownership from state that must revalidate current topology/occupancy. No historic schema/version migrator proven beyond optional keys and current reconstruction.

Destination missing or graph null returns early before clearing currentPath/wait fields; fresh Navigation defaults empty/null, reused instance could retain stale residual fields while inactive. No opaque destination tombstone for station restored later; next save of inactive Navigation empty loses intent.

removeBrokenPathEntries drops null node pairs but does not check edge connectivity or continuous planned path. navigateOptions on no saved match selects options[0] rather than stop/retain checkpoint; at junction unexpected topology can steer another route. Generic map order not asserted deterministic. Distinct a781 preserves failed full-wheel checkpoints; this route policy is deliberately weaker.

Read path list delegates Couple/NBTHelper and palette readers not fully audited here; malformed UUID, wrongtag, pair lengths, NaN/negative/huge distances/ticks not validated locally. Missing wait distance/ticks defaults0 can alter braking immediately.

waitingForChainedGroups not persisted and begins empty; currentSignalResolved cross-signal loop can return true on empty map before scout rebuild. No guarantee exact red-cross-signal wait restored on first tick, no freeze of old reservations. Global manager clears group.trains/reserved per tick and rebuilds earlyTick; full earlyTick/SignalEdgeGroup ownership engine not reread in this receipt.

Navigation.curve scan computes turn.starts before turn!=null guard; source TravellingPoint only invokes supplied turnListener after edge.isTurn but full edge/getTurn invariant not read. Do not claim proven runtime NPE or validation passes.

Navigation startNavigation mutates path/distance/clears signal state before conductor validation; failure may leave earlier destination with replaced path. cancelNavigation with null destination returns before reserved clearing. Reader/writer mutate state, no transaction/rollback.

write removes broken path entries from actual live list before saving; absent destination emits empty compound. No per-field markdirty; actual Train.tick calls markTracksDirty externally, native SavedData disk atomicity and file durable ack not audited. No actual game/reload test.

Saved ticksWaitingForSignal biases route cost; fullRefresh can call runtime.startCurrentInstruction to select a new route; saved path is not a fixed guarantee. Signals unresolved/missing may be treated passable, destination deleted terminates restoration. Full schedule engine is comparator support, not newly credited.
